headline: US Banks Reportedly Blocking Third-Party AI Agents from Customer Accounts
summary: U.S. banks are actively blocking third-party artificial intelligence agents from accessing customer bank accounts, according to industry sources.
why: Security and data privacy protocols implemented by financial institutions govern how emerging fintech and AI applications interact with core banking infrastructure.

impacts.name: Banking
impacts.why: Restricting unauthorized automated access protects traditional banking infrastructure against security vulnerabilities and liability risks.
